tools.name: qimen_chart
tools.description: Cast an hour-based Qi Men Dun Jia (奇门遁甲) chart for a moment and place: four pillars, ju, Chief Star and Door, and for each of the nine palaces the deity, star, door, heaven/earth/hidden stems, void, horse star, punishment and door pressure, plus detected patterns, palace scores for the chosen focus

tools.name: bazi_pillars
tools.description: Four Pillars (八字) for a birth moment: converts the clock time with the zone rules for that date (daylight saving included) and the longitude to true solar time; the year follows Li Chun and the day changes at 23:00 true solar time. Returns the pillars, Day Master, five-element counts and the time co

tools.name: best_times
tools.description: Cast a Qi Men chart for every double-hour of the next few days and rank them for a goal, using the person's Day Master from the birth date. Returns the top windows with date, hour branch, true-solar-time range, score and the lucky direction at that time.

tools.name: solar_terms
tools.description: The 24 solar terms (节气) of a calendar year, 1900-2100, with UTC and Beijing-time instants from the same table the charts use (within about a minute of the Hong Kong Observatory).
